prereq.p: Select the seal cartridge by model and serial number.

step.cmd: Record the installed seal part number and leakage position.
Remove the guard and access cover.
Loosen the retainer screws in an alternating sequence.
Withdraw the cartridge along the shaft without scoring the sleeve.
Torque the retainer screws alternately to 15 N·m.
Restore the cover and guard. Complete the functional test.
